highlights: Polygon mode: pick Points, Edges or Faces, then Extrude, Inset, Bevel, Edge loops and Span
Split view shows a second live view of your scene, each with its own camera
Place curves point by point, straight or smooth, and edit their points with the Gizmo
An orientation widget in the canvas corner: click a dot to look from that side
Remesh one click away: right-click or Space for Quick Remesh, Quad Remesh and Remove Hidden
